{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check premises
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
print("Unique severity values:", df['severity'].unique())
print("Unique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())
print("Unique biomarker_baseline values (first 10):", df['biomarker_baseline'].unique()[:10])

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check if 'severe' is in severity
has_severe = 'severe' in df['severity'].unique()

# Check if biomarker_baseline is in ng/mL (no unit conversion needed for baseline)
# According to documentation: only biomarker_final has unit issue (batch B is µg/L, needs /10)
# biomarker_baseline is unaffected

# Report findings
findings = {
    "has_severe_disease": has_severe,
    "sentinel_in_baseline": sentinel_count > 0,
    "baseline_unit_correct": True,  # confirmed by doc
    "batch_a_in_ngml": True,  # batch A is already ng/mL
    "batch_b_in_ngml": True,  # baseline is in ng/mL regardless
    "premises_verified": has_severe and sentinel_count > 0
}

findings"}
